t.en: Therefore we can find $\vect{x}$, the solution to the system, by computing $\vect{x} = A^{-1}\vect{b}$. Note that once we have found $A^{-1}$, we can easily get the solution for different right-hand sides (different $\vect{b}$). It is always just $A^{-1}\vect{b}$.
